messages:
Riley (Employee): hey team ":wave:" quick q — my religious holiday (date not on company calendar) falls during our year-end performance blackout (first week of Jan). I asked my manager if i can take that day. What's the policy for religious observance days that aren't company holidays?

Mark (Manager): Riley flagged this earlier. I'd like to approve the day off and not force them to use PTO if possible. Can People Ops confirm what we can do and what docs we need?

Sam (People Ops): short answer: we accommodate religious observances. Options: (1) approve unpaid time off, (2) ask employee to use PTO, or (3) grant one-time floating day/exception if manager + People Ops approve. For blackout weeks tied to performance, we prefer swaps or remote presence during calibration.

Deena (HRBP): policy note: Religious accommodations are protected. We shouldn't require documentation beyond a simple written request unless there's an abuse pattern. But because this conflicts with performance blackout, we need to ensure calibration attendance. If they can't attend their slot, manager must arrange an alternate reviewer or reschedule the employee's calibration.

Legal Bot: Reminder: treat religious accommodation requests as protected under company nondiscrimination policy. Avoid requiring proof. Exceptions to blackout should be assessed for undue hardship on business operations, not on employee belief. See: https://redwood.example/legal/religious-accomms

PeopleOps Bot: FYI: blackout exceptions must be logged as CAL_BLOCK exceptions with manager note. If granting a paid one-time credit, use EXC_TYPE: REL_ACCOM and attach approval.

Riley (Employee): i can attend my calibration slot remotely that week but will need the actual day off for observance. Prefer not to burn PTO.

Mark (Manager): i can confirm Riley will be online for their calibration slot. I approve granting a one-time paid floating day for this religious observance so they don't use PTO.

Sam (People Ops): great. I'll file EXC-2028-900 REL_ACCOM and schedule a one-time +1 day PTO credit (labeled "Religious accommodation: one-time credit"). Jasper, can you run the hrcli command on 2028-01-02? Example:
```
hrcli adjust-balance --user riley.j --add 1 --type PTO --note "Religious accommodation EXC-2028-900; manager approved; calibration presence required"
```

Jasper L.: noted. i'll queue EXC-2028-900 and schedule the HRIS update on 2028-01-02 EOD. Payroll Bot, any payroll/tax flags?

Payroll Bot: One-time PTO credit has no retro pay implications; no tax issue. Just ensure EXC id is attached for audit.

Sam (People Ops): filing EXC-2028-900 now and adding note: manager confirmation present; employee will attend calibration remotely. Riley, we'll credit the day and mark it as REL_ACCOM. Closing loop after HRIS update. :white_check_mark:

Riley (Employee): thanks everyone — appreciate the flexibility and clarity.

PeopleOps Bot: Action created: EXC-2028-900. Reminder: keep documentation minimal for religious requests; do not require proof. Link: https://redwood.example/hr/exceptions/EXC-2028-900
